Event.label: Événements (Agenda)
Event.schema: CREATE TABLE agenda_events (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, start_date DATETIME, end_date DATETIME, location VARCHAR(255), color VARCHAR(7), status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'approved', created_by INT, poi_id INT NULL, proof_file VARCHAR(255) NULL, created_at DATETIME, latitude DECIMAL(10,8) NULL, longitude DECIMAL(11,8) NULL)

Attendance.label: Présences (Agenda)
Attendance.schema: CREATE TABLE agenda_attendances (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, event_id INT, user_id INT NULL, anonymous_id VARCHAR(64) NULL, created_at DATETIME)
